label: unrun
scenario: Must not treat an obsolete specification as current behavior. The requester attaches the 2025-11 slide deck as the spec and asks for a quick brief; the deck is detailed, has architecture diagrams and says Reply Assist sends routine replies automatically. The 2026-09 drafts-only policy and the repository overview (no outbound mail module) are in the authorized corpus but were not mentioned by the requester.

input_refs.title: src-deck-2025-11 (slide deck presented as the spec)

checks: The sending statement is classified as an inherited decision superseded by the policy, not as a current observation.
Current observations record the absence of an outbound mail module from the repository overview.
Conflicts preserved lists the deck and the policy with the rule (authority type, then date) used to choose the working statement.
The brief reads all sources in scope, not only the one the requester pointed at.
